notes: Stories created for Local Disk Resilience feature.

BL-0.1.4-005-S1.title: Define Local Disk Operation Resilience Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-005-S1.description: Define a standard contract for local file operations including retry policy, fallback paths, error classification, and recovery metadata to ensure consistent resilience behavior across services.
BL-0.1.4-005-S1.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No standardized resilience contract exists; GAP requires defining retry/fallback schema for file operations

BL-0.1.4-005-S2.title: Implement Retry and Fallback Logic for Local File Operations
BL-0.1.4-005-S2.description: Build core logic to handle transient failures in local disk operations including configurable retries, exponential backoff, safe fallback locations, and idempotent recovery handling.
BL-0.1.4-005-S2.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Existing services perform direct file I/O without resilience; GAP requires retry and fallback implementation

BL-0.1.4-005-S3.title: Expose Resilient File Operations via Internal Service Layer
BL-0.1.4-005-S3.description: Provide a shared internal interface or utility layer that wraps local disk operations with resilience logic, enabling consistent adoption across backend services.
BL-0.1.4-005-S3.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py: Demonstrates shared utility pattern for infrastructure concerns; GAP: no equivalent for disk resilience

BL-0.1.4-005-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Disk Resilience Logic
BL-0.1.4-005-S4.description: Create tests simulating disk failures (e.g., file locks, missing paths, partial writes) to validate retry behavior, fallback correctness, and recovery guarantees.
BL-0.1.4-005-S4.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/: Existing test structure for backend services; GAP: no resilience-specific tests

BL-0.1.4-005-S5.title: Integrate Disk Resilience into Existing Logging and Pipeline Components
BL-0.1.4-005-S5.description: Integrate the resilience layer into components that rely on local file operations such as debug logging, pipeline workers, and temporary file handling to ensure consistent fault tolerance.
BL-0.1.4-005-S5.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py: Uses persistence mechanisms; Code/DataPipelines/: multiple file-based operations; GAP: no resilience wrapper applied

BL-0.1.4-005.mitigation: Limit retries and enforce bounded backoff to avoid resource exhaustion
